info.name: 🔐 Authentication
info.description:
## 🔐 Authentication Endpoints

Manage user authentication, registration, login, logout, and token refresh.

### 📋 Available Endpoints

- **Sign Up**: Register a new customer account
- **Register Business**: Register a new business owner (creates BusinessProfile, sends welcome email)
- **Login**: Authenticate and get access/refresh tokens
- **Logout**: End current session
- **Refresh Token**: Get new access token using refresh token

**Note**: For session management endpoints (list sessions, delete sessions, etc.), see the "📱 User Sessions" section.
**Note**: For user profile endpoints, see the "👥 Users" section.

**Important**: The `role` field in Sign Up is now optional and will always be set to `customer` automatically. You can omit it from the request body.

item.name: 📝 Sign Up
item.description:
## 📝 Register New User

Register a new user account in the system.

### 📥 Request Body

```json
{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "Password123",
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "role": "customer"
}
```

### ✅ Success Response (201 Created)

```json
{
  "message": "User registered successfully",
  "user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "user@example.com"
  },
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "refresh_expires_in": 604800
}
```

**Note**: Authentication tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` and `refresh_token`) for security.

**Response Fields:**
- `message`: Confirmation message
- `user`: Newly created user information (id, email)
- `token_type`: Type of token (always "Bearer")
- `expires_in`: Access token expiration time in seconds (900 = 15 minutes)
- `refresh_expires_in`: Refresh token expiration time in seconds (604800 = 7 days)

**HTTP Headers:**
- `Location`: URI of the created resource (e.g., `/api/user/me`)

**HTTP Status Code**: `201 Created` - Sign up creates a new user resource, so it returns 201 Created.

### 🔄 Auto-Actions

- ✅ Automatically extracts `access_token` from cookies and saves to environment
- ✅ Automatically extracts `refresh_token` from cookies and saves to environment
- ✅ Automatically saves `user_id` to environment
- ✅ Automatically saves `user_email` to environment

exec: console.log('✅ Access token saved from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Access token cookie not found');
console.log('✅ Refresh token saved from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Refresh token cookie not found');
console.error('Sign up failed with status:', pm.response.code);

request.description: Register a new user account with email, password, full name, and profile type. Returns user info. Authentication tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies.

item.name: 🏢 Register Business
item.description:
## 🏢 Register Business Account

Register a new business owner account. Creates a user with role `business_owner`, a BusinessProfile, and sends a welcome email (if RESEND_API_KEY is configured).

### 📥 Request Body

```json
{
  "email": "owner@business.com",
  "password": "Password123!",
  "firstName": "John",
  "lastName": "Doe",
  "businessName": "Mi Negocio S.A.",
  "referralCode": "ABC123"
}
```

**Required fields:**
- `email`: Valid email address
- `password`: Min 8 characters
- `firstName`, `lastName`: Owner names
- `businessName`: Business/company name

**Optional:**
- `referralCode`: 6-12 alphanumeric characters (referral program)

### ✅ Success Response (201 Created)

```json
{
  "message": "Business account registered successfully",
  "user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "owner@business.com",
    "firstName": "John",
    "lastName": "Doe",
    "role": "business_owner"
  },
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "refresh_expires_in": 604800,
  "sessionId": "uuid"
}
```

**Note**: Authentication tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` and `refresh_token`).

**Response Fields:**
- `message`: Confirmation message
- `user`: Newly created business owner (id, email, firstName, lastName, role)
- `token_type`, `expires_in`, `refresh_expires_in`: Token metadata
- `sessionId`: Current session ID

**HTTP Headers:**
- `Location`: `/api/user/me`

### ⚠️ Error Responses

- **400**: Invalid input (validation failed)
- **401**: Email already in use

### 📧 Welcome Email

On successful registration, a welcome email is sent to the provided email (requires `RESEND_API_KEY` and `MAIL_FROM` in .env). If not configured, registration still succeeds.

### 🔄 Auto-Actions

- ✅ Extracts `access_token` and `refresh_token` from cookies
- ✅ Saves `user_id` and `user_email` to environment

request.description: Register a new business owner account. Creates BusinessProfile and sends welcome email. Tokens via HttpOnly cookies.

item.name: 🔑 Login
item.description:
## 🔑 User Login

Authenticate user and receive access/refresh tokens.

### 📥 Request Body

```json
{
  "email": "{{user_email}}",
  "password": "{{user_password}}"
}
```

### ✅ Success Response (200 OK)

```json
{
  "user": {
    "id": "uuid",
    "email": "user@example.com"
  },
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "refresh_expires_in": 604800
}
```

**Note**: Authentication tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` and `refresh_token`) for security.

**Response Fields:**
- `user`: User information (id, email)
- `token_type`: Type of token (always "Bearer")
- `expires_in`: Access token expiration time in seconds (900 = 15 minutes)
- `refresh_expires_in`: Refresh token expiration time in seconds (604800 = 7 days)

**HTTP Status Code**: `200 OK` - Login is an authentication operation, not a resource creation, so it returns 200 OK instead of 201 Created.

### ⚠️ Error Responses

- **401 Unauthorized**: Invalid credentials
- **429 Too Many Requests**: Too many login attempts

### 🔄 Auto-Actions

- ✅ Automatically extracts `access_token` from cookies and saves to environment
- ✅ Automatically extracts `refresh_token` from cookies and saves to environment
- ✅ Automatically saves `user_id` to environment
- ✅ Automatically saves `user_email` to environment

### 💡 Usage

Use the environment variables `{{user_email}}` and `{{user_password}}` for quick login.

exec: console.log('✅ Access token saved from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Access token cookie not found');
console.log('✅ Refresh token saved from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Refresh token cookie not found');

request.description: Authenticate user. Access and refresh tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies for security.

item.name: 🔄 Refresh Token
item.description:
## 🔄 Refresh Access Token

Get a new access token using the refresh_token cookie.

**Note**: The refresh token must be sent via cookie `refresh_token`. Login or Sign Up first to receive cookies.

### ✅ Success Response (200 OK)

```json
{
  "token_type": "Bearer",
  "expires_in": 900,
  "refresh_expires_in": 604800
}
```

**Note**: New authentication tokens are sent as HttpOnly cookies (`access_token` and `refresh_token`).

**Response Fields:**
- `token_type`: Type of token (always "Bearer")
- `expires_in`: New access token expiration time in seconds (900 = 15 minutes)
- `refresh_expires_in`: Refresh token expiration time in seconds (604800 = 7 days)

### 🔄 Auto-Actions

- ✅ Automatically extracts `access_token` from cookies and updates environment
- ✅ Automatically extracts `refresh_token` from cookies and updates environment

exec: console.log('Refresh Token - Parsed response:', JSON.stringify(response, null, 2));
console.log('✅ Access token refreshed from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Access token cookie not found');
console.log('✅ Refresh token updated from cookie');
console.warn('⚠️ Refresh token cookie not found');
console.error('Error parsing refresh token response:', error);
console.error('Token refresh failed with status:', statusCode);

request.description: Refresh the access token using the refresh_token cookie. Returns token metadata and sets new tokens as HttpOnly cookies. Enable 'Send cookies' in Postman.

item.name: Logout
item.description:
## 🚪 User Logout

End the current session and invalidate the access token.

### 🔒 Authentication

Requires access_token cookie (sent automatically after login).

### ✅ Success Response (200 OK)

```json
{
  "message": "Successfully logged out"
}
```

**Note**: Authentication cookies (`access_token` and `refresh_token`) are cleared.

**HTTP Status Code**: `200 OK` - Logout is a state-changing operation that returns a confirmation message.

request.description: Logout from the current session. Invalidates the current access token and clears authentication cookies.
